# Primary Platform

Vendor: Juniper Networks

Platform: SRX320

Operating System: Junos OS

Primary Use Cases:

- Firewall configuration
- Security zones
- Security policies
- Source NAT
- Destination NAT
- Static NAT
- Routing
- Interface configuration
- VLANs
- System management
- Logging
- Monitoring
- Troubleshooting
- ScreenOS-to-Junos migration
- Production firewall operations
